name: Amaro CioCiaro
description: Amaro CioCiaro is a classic Italian herbal liqueur with a rich, complex profile rooted in traditional Italian amaro traditions. Created in 1860 by the Ciarlo family in Turin, it blends over 20 botanicals—including bitter orange peel, gentian root, rhubarb, and cinnamon—with a touch of sugar and alcohol. Its deep, aromatic flavor balances sweetness, bitterness, and herbal warmth, making it a versatile base for cocktails or a digestif.
